FULL TEXT:
Advertisement for the Post of Guest Faculty in the Department of Computer Science &
Applications, Panjab University, Chandigarh
Applications are invited for the post of ONE Guest Faculty to teach MCA/M.Sc. Computer
Science/CBCS/VAC subjects in the Department of Computer Science & Applications, Panjab
University, Chandigarh. Interested candidates are required to submit soft copy of the application
in the prescribed proforma available on the Panjab University website
https://forms.puchd.ac.in/forms/20170912173045-application-form-assistant-professor-4th-
16.pdf (Direct recruitment guest faculty application form as per UGC regulation 2018.pdf) along
with self-attested copies of all the relevant documents/certificates to the Chairperson,
Department of Computer Science & Application, Panjab University, Chandigarh at the e-mail Id
chairpersondcsa@pu.ac.in latest by 02.09.2026 at 5:00 PM. The candidates should also submit
the hard copy of the same by the due date to the office of the Chairperson, Department of
Computer Science & Applications, Panjab University, Chandigarh.
Eligibility (A OR B) :
A (i) MCA (Master of Computer Science & Applications)/ M.Sc. in Computer Science or IT
or Computer Applications/M.Tech or allied subject with at least 55% marks (or an equivalent
grade in a point scale wherever grading system is followed) from an Indian University, or an
equivalent degree from an accredited foreign university. A relaxation of 5% shall be provided for
the candidates belonging to Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe/Differently-abled/Other Backward
Classes (OBC) (Non-creamy Layer)/Ph.D. Degree holders, who have obtained their Master’s
Degree prior to 19 September, 1991.
(i) Besides fulfilling the above qualifications, the candidate must have cleared the National
Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by the UGC, CSIR or similar test accredited by the UGC like
SLET/SET or who are or have been awarded a Ph.D. degree in accordance with the University
Grants Commission. Provided further, candidates registered for the Ph.D. programme prior to
July 11, 2009, shall be exempted from the requirement of NET/SLET/SET subject to the
fulfillment of the following conditions:
a. Ph.D. degree of the candidate awarded in regular mode only.
b. Evaluation of the Ph.D. thesis by at least two external examiners.
c. An open Ph.D. viva voce of the candidate had been conducted.
d. Candidate has published two research papers from his/her Ph.D. work out of which at
least one must be in a refereed journal.
e. Candidate has made at least two presentations in conference/seminars, based on his/her
Ph.D. work.
(a) to (e) as above are to be certified by the Registrar/Dean (Academic Affairs).
Or
B. The Ph.D degree has been obtained from a foreign university/institution with a ranking
among top 500 in the World University Ranking (at any time) by any one of the following:
(i) Quacquarelli Symonds (QS), or (ii) the Times Higher Education (THE), or (iii) the Academic
Ranking of World Universities (ARWU) of the Shanghai Jiao Tong University (Shanghai).
The above assignment will be on lecture basis with a token honorarium of Rs.1500/- per lecture
with an upper limit of Rs.50,000/- per month. The candidate will have to give an undertaking
that he/she will not draw any fellowship / stipend or any financial assistance from any agency till
they are teaching in the Department of Computer Science & Applications, Panjab University,
Chandigarh as a Guest Faculty. The candidates who are already availing JRF scholarships in the
University are not entitled for the honorarium but they will be issued experience certificate for
the Guest Faculty. The candidates are required to submit a No Objection Certificate from the
present employer along with their application.
The interview for the post will be held in the office of the Chairperson, Department of Computer
Science & Application, Panjab University, Chandigarh. The date and time of the interview will
be intimated to the shortlisted candidates by e-mail. The applicants are advised to bring their
original certificates and other relevant documents for verification at the time of interview.
Note: No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.
